Sports · India

Indian athletes win medals at Commonwealth Games 2026

Indian athletes secured multiple medals at the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow. Weightlifter Mirabai Chanu won India's first gold medal, while Rishikanta Singh claimed a silver. Boxer Jaismine Lamboria is also competing for gold, and the women's lawn bowls pair and a men's boxing bout against Pakistan also saw success. The Indian women's TT team reached the semifinals.
